create_compressed_tensors_quantizer: create a CompressedTensorsHfQuantizer instance with a CompressedTensorsConfig to load quantized models
validate_compressed_tensors_environment: validate that the compressed-tensors library is available before loading a quantized model
update_model_dtype_float16: update the model dtype to torch.float16 for better efficiency with compressed_tensors quantization
compress_model_before_weight_loading: compress the model weights before loading using the ModelCompressor from compressed_tensors
decompress_model_after_weight_loading: decompress the loaded model for quantization-aware training when run_compressed is disabled
